_comment: spinup suggests no skills: which skills you want is yours to decide, not spinup's. A fresh machine installs nothing and parks nothing. Your own skills are folders in ~/.spinup/skills (`spinup skills new|import|adopt`); `spinup skills add <owner/repo> <skill>` fetches one from GitHub when you ask for it. Your first `spinup skills add|remove|manual|auto` copies this file to your library (~/.spinup/skills.json) and uses that from then on. Keep the list small: every auto-triggered skill's description costs tokens in every session. `manual`: installed, but only run when called (/name, $name). Which agents get them is not listed here: spinup installs for the agents it finds on each machine.
